# Trade Document Fixtures

PDF and image samples in this directory are local-only and excluded by Git.
Their names or use in tests do not establish permission to redistribute them.

Do not add customer documents or use `git add -f` to upload these files. Shared
fixtures must be explicitly reviewed synthetic data with a documented source.

Runtime code must not import files from this directory. Live OCR/model tests
require separate configuration and authorization; local samples are not bundled.
